copy_policy: Copy exact listed regular files only. Verify sha256 and size before copying; if source changed, exclude or take a newly documented snapshot. Do not follow broad directory globs or execute any retained script. Preserve existing relative group paths under the evidence bundle.

exclusions.reason: Build outputs and proof caches are bulky, mutable, and not a substitute for retained report evidence.
Do not bulk-copy source/worktree duplicates. Parent separately freezes intended source Git head.

Very large verbose streams excluded from compact public bundle. They remain local; negative result and diagnosis records are selected. Do not describe the public bundle as containing complete original raw streams.
Ongoing or recently changing work; previous audit retains bounded observations. Do not copy live partially written state.
Private communication, full transcripts and credential material do not belong in this checkpoint.

Historical evidence is not proof of the intended publication source head.
Earlier audit report status predates later merges; preserve its timestamp and source identity.

screening.method: Read-only high-specificity pattern scan over selected bytes for private keys, common provider-secret forms, bearer token values and conversation URLs. No matching file found. This is a bounded screen, not a proof of absence of all sensitive content.
